valuation.valuation_basis: Single FORWARD binary: opakalim/BHV-7000 (selective Kv7.2/7.3 activator) topline from the FIRST of TWO pivotal Ph2/3 refractory-focal-epilepsy studies, 2H-2026. Supportive prior data: 54% achieved >=50% seizure reduction over 6mo, triple time-to-seizure, low CNS-AE / differentiated tolerability (>1000 subjects). Textbook single-readout-without-clear-mispricing: won't register on one study, and epilepsy adjunctive trials carry placebo-response variance. Cash $351.8M (3/31/26) / 105.865M sh = $3.32/sh — but BHVN retains multiple shots (Graves', IgAN, SMA-adjacent) so a miss does NOT cut to cash. win_prob 0.55 = Kv7 mechanism clinically validated (ezogabine precedent) + strong Ph2 effect, discounted for single-study + placebo risk + need to confirm in study 2. target_on_win $18 ~ FMP consensus median $18 (cons $17.6); downside_on_loss $6 (re-rates down hard but residual pipeline+cash floor >$3.32 cash). EV barbell: 0.55*(18-11.18)+0.45*(6-11.18)= +$1.42/sh (~+13% EV, but high variance). reference_rr (EV%)=(18-11.18)/(11.18-6)=1.32.
valuation.prob_basis: Kv7.2/7.3 mechanism de-risked by ezogabine/retigabine precedent + opakalim Ph2 efficacy (54% >=50% responders, well tolerated). Capped at 0.55 because this is FIRST of two registration studies (no filing on a single readout) and adjunctive focal-epilepsy placebo response is a known confounder.

valuation.valuation_basis: Tinlarebant (oral RBP4 antagonist) for Stargardt (STGD1): rolling NDA initiated Apr 21 2026, Q2-2026 submission-completion guidance. Pivotal Ph3 DRAGON POSITIVE (n=104, statistically significant ~36% reduction in retinal-lesion growth rate, favorable safety). Designations: Breakthrough + Fast Track + Rare-Pediatric + Orphan (US/EU/JP) + Sakigake. So the binary is more approval-timing/label than efficacy — efficacy already cleared. Cash+ST+LT investments ~$772.6M (12/31/25: $352.9M+$139.5M+$280.2M) / 40.085M sh = $19.27/sh cash. win_prob 0.78 = positive pivotal + 4 expedited designations sharply de-risk approval; residual = first-disease-precedent/CMC/single-pivotal-adequacy risk. target_on_win $208 = FMP consensus (high $217/low $191, median $215). downside_on_loss $60: NOT cash ($19) — a CRL/delay with positive Stargardt data + GA (PHOENIX) read-through would re-rate to ~yearLow $56 area, not to liquidation. But note asymmetry: at $139 the stock already prices most of the win (49% upside to $208) vs ~57% downside to $60. EV barbell: 0.78*(208-139.31)+0.22*(60-139.31)= +$36.1/sh (~+26% EV). reference_rr=(208-139.31)/(139.31-60)=0.87.
valuation.prob_basis: Positive pivotal Ph3 DRAGON (met primary, ~36% lesion-growth reduction, clean safety) + Breakthrough/Fast Track/RPD/Orphan designations de-risk the approval path; discounted from ~0.85 for single-pivotal adequacy in a first-ever-approved indication and CMC/rolling-review execution.

Net effect: maturity wall pushed 2028/30 -> 2032/34, secured coupon cut ~130bps on ~$1.9B (~$25M/yr interest saved), gross debt ~flat-to-+$0.1B. BORR is a going concern (not bankrupt), so 'recovery' = equity-on-EV. Q1-2026 was soft (rev $247M -5% QoQ, Adj EBITDA $88.5M, -$29M net loss, tender delays from ME conflict) but 2026 coverage 71% at ~$137k/day, Dayrate-Equiv Backlog $1.17B, fleet 34 rigs post-Noble. recovery_value $5.50 = ~5.5x normalized mid-cycle Adj EBITDA ~$600M = $3.3B EV less post-refi net debt ~$2.2B = ~$1.1B / ~316M dil sh, i.e. a modest re-rate on de-risking + lagged dayrate recovery (mgmt guides recovery lags oil 6-12mo).
